name: Zhejiang Asia-Pacific Mechanical & Electronic Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Asia-Pacific Mechanical & Electronic Co.,Ltd engages in the development, production, and sale of automotive parts and accessories in China and internationally. It offers automotive basic brake systems, automotive chassis electronic intelligent control systems, wheel motors, and wire-controlled chassis. The company also provides electronics, intelligent driving, hub motors, brake calipers, brake disc, disc brake assembly, drum brakes, pumps, and commercial vehicle brake products. Zhejiang Asia-Pacific Mechanical & Electronic Co.,Ltd was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
